programs.title: F+
programs.desc: A family comedy aimed at teenagers.Ted (Wells Rappaport) and Josh (James Williams Jr.) are best friends and go to the Magnet School for Math and Science together.Ted is a star student, and Josh specializes in creating gadgets that they then use to prank others.After one of such antics, they are suspended.They must be careful because the next time will result in expulsion from school.The situation becomes more complicated when they fail the most important exam.The same fate befell Penny (Lily Jane), Ted's rival.Convinced that something was wrong with the test itself, they team up with a magician and a hacker to try to destroy the results during the school dance and give themselves a chance to improve.

programs.title: Creator
programs.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.

programs.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programs.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programs.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programs.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programs.title: Amrum
programs.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

programs.title: Materialists
programs.desc: Lucy (Dakota Johnson), an employee of a luxury dating agency, measures her professional success by having nine arranged marriages.Together with her colleagues, she recruits clients based on their market value, which is determined by financial status, education and age.She follows a similar logic herself.She ended her five-year relationship because her boyfriend John (Chris Evans) had too little income.Now she is single and waiting for a rich man whom she will quickly marry.Fate sends her Harry (Pedro Pascal), the owner of an apartment worth... 12 million dollars.A relationship with him, even without love, becomes a beneficial investment for her and a guarantee of a high standard of living.But then John appears on the horizon again and, against her better judgment, Lucy begins to have doubts...
